```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(arrow)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(jsonlite)
library(knitr)
library(tidyr)

data_root <- Sys.getenv(
  "GIBBON_DATA_ROOT",
  unset = "/srv/gibbon-activations/gpt_oss_pilot_3games"
)
selected_game_id <- params$game_id
stopifnot(selected_game_id %in% c("high_0056", "low_0056", "high_0066"))

log_path <- file.path(data_root, "logs", paste0(selected_game_id, ".json"))
activation_path <- file.path(
  data_root, "activations", paste0(selected_game_id, "_attempt_000.parquet")
)
stopifnot(file.exists(log_path), file.exists(activation_path))

game <- read_json(log_path, simplifyVector = FALSE)
cues <- unlist(game$all_cues)
```

## Game summary

```{r game-summary}
summary_table <- tibble(
  game_id = game$game_id,
  reasoning_effort = game$reasoning_effort,
  correct_cue = game$correct_cue,
  final_choice = game$final_decision$choice,
  success = game$success,
  activation_rows = game$activation_rows,
  layers = game$num_layers,
  hidden_size = game$hidden_size
)
kable(summary_table)
```

## Evidence stream and availability mask

Every row below is one evidence round. Round numbers are displayed as 1–15,
while the stored JSON uses 0–14.

```{r round-data}
rounds <- bind_rows(lapply(game$rounds, function(x) {
  available <- unlist(x$available_cues)
  tibble(
    round = x$round + 1L,
    choice = x$choice,
    observed_color = x$observed_color,
    available_cues = paste(available, collapse = ", "),
    n_available = length(available)
  )
}))
kable(rounds)
```

The panel shows every button in every round. Dark cells are occluded, light
cells are available but not selected, and the selected cell is colored by the
observed evidence.

```{r game-panel, fig.width=7, fig.height=8}
panel <- bind_rows(lapply(game$rounds, function(x) {
  available <- unlist(x$available_cues)
  tibble(
    round = x$round + 1L,
    cue = cues,
    is_available = cues %in% available,
    is_selected = cues == x$choice,
    observed_color = x$observed_color
  )
})) %>%
  mutate(
    state = case_when(
      !is_available ~ "occluded",
      is_selected & observed_color == "RED" ~ "selected: red",
      is_selected & observed_color == "GREEN" ~ "selected: green",
      TRUE ~ "available"
    ),
    label = if_else(is_selected, "●", "")
  )

ggplot(panel, aes(x = cue, y = factor(round, levels = rev(1:15)))) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = state), color = "white", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), color = "white", size = 6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "occluded" = "#252525",
    "available" = "#bdbdbd",
    "selected: red" = "#d73027",
    "selected: green" = "#1a9850"
  )) +
  labs(x = "Button", y = "Round", fill = NULL) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom")
```

## Basic behavioral statistics

```{r behavioral-statistics}
behavior_stats <- rounds %>%
  summarise(
    rounds = n(),
    red_observations = sum(observed_color == "RED"),
    green_observations = sum(observed_color == "GREEN"),
    mean_available_buttons = mean(n_available),
    distinct_buttons_chosen = n_distinct(choice)
  )
kable(behavior_stats)

choice_counts <- rounds %>% count(choice, observed_color, name = "observations")
kable(choice_counts)
```

## Activation index statistics

Only the five metadata columns are read here; none of the 2,880 activation
dimensions are materialized in R.

```{r activation-index}
activation_index <- read_parquet(
  activation_path,
  col_select = c(game_id, round, layer, activation_site, token_idx)
)

activation_summary <- activation_index %>%
  summarise(
    rows = n(),
    rounds = n_distinct(round),
    layers = n_distinct(layer),
    sites = n_distinct(activation_site),
    token_indices = n_distinct(token_idx)
  )
kable(activation_summary)

rows_by_round <- activation_index %>% count(round, activation_site)
ggplot(rows_by_round, aes(round, n, color = activation_site)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_viridis_d(end = 0.85) +
  labs(x = "Stored round index", y = "Activation rows", color = "Site") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

## Next step

Use `python/load_activations.py` to stream an exact BF16 row group. Keep the
`uint16` representation when testing a new format so bitwise round trips can
be verified before numerical analysis.
